Company description: The National Biodiversity Future Center (NBFC) focuses on the Mediterranean region, considered a biodiversity hotspot, in order to address global challenges related to the following:
-Knowledge and protection of Italian biodiversity;
-Monitoring of different species, including rare, endangered and exotic pest species;
-Development of appropriate 'Restoration Ecology' strategies also with the aim of achieving the goals of the Nature Restoration Law;
-Enhancement of biodiversity through innovation actions that produce economic, environmental and social value.
Through targeted research and adoption of new technologies, NBFC provides intervention bodies and territorial administrations with the scientific basis for the establishment and management of protected areas, the design and implementation of efficient monitoring systems, the implementation of ecological restoration programs, and the enhancement of biodiversity to obtain new food, medical, cosmetics, and new materials. An entire sector of the center is dedicated to innovation, the involvement of national and international companies and institutions to support sustainable production processes, stimulate the creation of start-ups and expand green jobs. In this area, the center works with industrial supply chains by identifying process innovations and studying innovative biotechnological solutions that make it possible to promote circular productions, enhancing the value of raw materials and revitalizing strategic sectors for Italy such as the nursery sector, fishing, aquaculture and the production of bioactive compounds. The NBFC is therefore proposed as a national and international reference for generating knowledge and value from biodiversity and transferring them to the territory with the aim of implementing ecosystem services, promoting the well-being of people and generating social and environmental economic value for society.

entityDescription:
Magnestar Technologies, S.L. designs, manufactures and qualifies high temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets and magnet subsystems for equipment manufacturers. 

Magnestar sits between the HTS tape suppliers and the OEMs that need a working magnet. The customer brings an application requirement: field, current, operating temperature, envelope and duty cycle. Magnestar covers electromagnetic and mechanical design, conductor selection and sourcing, winding and impregnation, cryogenic integration, quench detection and protection, and cold testing, and delivers a magnet subsystem that the customer integrates into its own equipment. Magnestar does not sell the end product and does not compete with its customers.

Magnestar currently runs paid engineering contracts on gyrotron magnets for plasma heating, fusion test infrastructure, and superconducting linear ny. Ongoing engineering discussions cover medical imaging, particle therapy, semiconductor crystal growth equipment and power delivery for data centers. For space applications the capability is the sa magnets, superconducting linear machines, andthe cryogenic and protection hardware around them.

Company description: eXact lab Srl is a privately held technology company spun off in 2011 from SISSA (Scuola Internazionale Superiore di Studi Avanzati, Trieste). It is registered as a Benefit Company, combining commercial objectives with measurable environmental and social value creation. The board comprises Prof. Stefano Cozzini (co-founder), Francesco De Giorgi (co-founder, CEO), and Giuseppe Piero Brandino, PhD (CTO).
eXact lab specialises in scientific computing, high-performance computing (HPC), scientific software development, and data infrastructure. Its staff come almost entirely from scientific and research backgrounds — nearly half hold a PhD in Physics, Mathematics, Geophysics, or Civil Engineering — giving the company the technical depth to operate at the intersection of research and engineering. Its core services are:
software design and optimisation for large-scale data processing;

HPC infrastructure design, deployment, and management;

software performance optimisation;

AI and machine learning for scientific and industrial applications;

training in technologies related to the activities above.

The company is organised in two main business units. The Operations BU covers provisioning, administration, and management of HPC infrastructure. The Development BU covers all software development activities and is divided into Data Science and HPC sub-units. As is typical of a SME, boundaries between units are intentionally permeable: project teams are cross-disciplinary and staff contribute across the full stack, so that expertise in HPC, data engineering, and scientific software is distributed rather than siloed.

eXact lab has extensive experience across the full value chain of Earth Observation data: from devising and deploying the compute-intensive processing pipelines that turn raw sensor data into scientific products, to designing and managing the data infrastructure that makes those products discoverable and accessible, to building the programmatic interfaces that end users rely on in operational workflows. This end-to-end familiarity — spanning production, distribution, and use of EO data — is directly relevant to a contract requiring user-driven maintenance and development of a key component of the Copernicus Marine Service ecosystem such as the toolbox.

entityDescription:
Balogh Statikus Iroda Kft is an engineering firm specializing in complex structural and civil engineering analysis and design. Our core operations focus on providing detailed static and dynamic calculations for both vertical (building) and horizontal (civil) structures, with a design portfolio primarily spanning across Europe and the United States. This international presence has equipped our team with extensive experience in operating under diverse regulatory frameworks, ensuring full compliance with Eurocode as well as US-specific building codes and standards.
The office manages the complete structural design process, from conceptual development to the delivery of detailed construction documentation. Our expertise in building construction includes the design of reinforced concrete, structural steel, and masonry load-bearing systems. In the field of civil engineering, our experience extends to the specialized design of underground spaces and subsurface structures, as well as large-scale retaining structures. Our tunnelling expertise encompasses various methodologies, including the Shotcrete Lining (SCL), Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) technology, and Cut-and-Cover techniques, along with deep foundation systems and complex soil-structure interaction analysis.
We utilize advanced Finite Element Method (FEM) software to model non-linear structural behaviour and optimize material efficiency in challenging subterranean environments. Balogh Statikus Iroda Kft. prioritizes analytical accuracy and structural safety, delivering engineering solutions that meet the rigorous technical demands of both the European and American construction markets.

entityDescription: Space42 Europe Srls - hereafter Space42 - is an Italian start-up company, founded in 2019, by a network of professional scientific explainers with more than 12 years of experience in communicating science and technology-related topics to the public. Space42 designs multimedia materials, presentations, hands-on workshops for young students, participates in science-themed public events on its own behalf or in support of national and international scientific entities. All proposed scientific activities and laboratories are indeed designed and implemented by Space42 experts and coordinated, during the event, by scientific explainers directly provided by the company. All materials needed for workshops are also prepared by the team and made available to the students during the activities. Each event is run by Space42 professionals, eventually supported by volunteers provided by partner institutions. Space42 has collaborations with the European Space Agency, the Italian Space Agency, the Distretto Tecnologico Aerospaziale, Il Cielo Itinerante, Asia Onlus, Camera di Commercio di Roma, Parmalat, Frascati Scienza, Unicef and ENEL for the organization of scientific events, festivals and tours throughout Italy addressed to young generations, with the aim of disseminating Space and Science in general and promoting the study of STEM disciplines. In particular, the network collaborates with the European Space Agency since 2017, for the organization of a wide variety of dissemination events in Italy and in Europe. As such, Space42 is responsible for all visits to the ESA - ESRIN Italian establishment for primary and secondary schools. On behalf of the Agency, Space42 participates in major scientific events and festivals in Italy and abroad. The group collaborated with the Italian Space Agency as well, in the years 2018, 2019 to plan, manage and coordinate the ASI one-week Open Days and the European Researchers Night in 2022. In 2020, 2021 and 2022 Space42 worked with Il Cielo Itinerante organization bringing scientific labs throughout Italy, with a special focus on educationally disadvantaged areas. The 2022 tour covered 45 dates throughout the country.

LUMETIS is a young start-up founded after 10 years of technology and know-how development in scientific and technical optical instrumentation. LUMETIS has recently been selected to reach the lunar incubation programme called “TechTheMoon” thanks to strong perspectives of its patented technologies for human and robotic exploration. 
One of our most noteworthy results is the invention and development of a fluorescence and reflectance hyperspectral imaging system reaching unprecedented spectral range (300 nm – 1000 nm) and sensitivity. Besides, LUMETIS has demonstrated being able to acquire fluorescence images of rocks, plants and contaminations on sensitive surfaces outside dark conditions of laboratories and therefore allowed the exploration of new technical and scientific fields. Last but not least, we have imagined and set up a multispectral (8 wavelengths) high resolution demonstrator for art applications. 
LUMETIS employs technologies invented by its founders within CNES and CNRS ecosystems. Some of the inventions were patented for space applications, improved for art applications and will be made even more outstanding before going back to space.

AgrOps GmbH is a Dortmund-based (NRW, Germany) technology start-up developing an AI-powered digital service for European agriculture.The company builds an end-to-end platform that supports farmers with Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) subsidy applications, mandatory documentation obligations (e.g. plant protection product records), and services e.g. for the transition from conventional to organic farming, accessed through a low-threshold, messaging-based interface.

AgrOps is currently extending its service with a satellite-based crop stressanalysis module, combining Earth observation data (Copernicus Sentinel-2)with proprietary (private) farm data to detect early plant and soil stress indicators.The goal is to enable more precise, resource-efficient use of fertilisers and plant protection products, reducing environmental impact while improving yield outcomes for small and medium-sized agricultural businesses.

AgrOps GmbH is a startup (Kleinstunternehmen) registered in the commercial register of the Amtsgericht Dortmund (HRB 38382), founded in 2026.

The company is established with the primary objective of transferring and disseminating technological innovations to the agricultural sector to promote sustainable agriculture models.
Specifically, the company aims to develop the use of remote sensing as an information framework for operating agricultural machinery equipped with Variable Rate Technology (VRT), as well as to provide technology transfer services. These services encompass the acquisition, processing, and distribution of data derived from remote sensing, advanced sensor systems, and IT infrastructure to business entities—including agricultural enterprises, machinery manufacturers, agricultural contractors, and producers' associations—for precision and sustainable agriculture applications.
The company's activities include support actions (dissemination, demonstration, training, system design, technical consultancy) aimed at implementing a georeferenced information service platform. Supported by the qualified contributions of consortium partners and external service providers, this platform enables the application of satellite imagery to precision farming and the broader agro-environmental sector.
A further objective of the company is to diversify and expand its addressable market by offering technological innovation services to the agricultural sector and agricultural machinery manufacturers, as well as remote sensing services applied to the environmental sector and to land management issues that benefit from satellite mapping. entityDescription:
LGr Technologies AS is a Norwegian deep-tech SME based in Trondheim, developing modular, lightweight sensor systems for situational awareness in harsh and remote environments.
The company's core products are MLTS (Mobile Lightweight Tactical Sensor), a rapidly deployable perimeter sensor node that can be carried and installed by a single person and operates unattended for up to two weeks (approximately eight days at -30 degC), and Heimdall, a command-and-control software platform that fuses data from distributed MLTS nodes into a single real-time situational picture. A third system, Munin, a semi-autonomous human-in-the-loop UAV platform that responds to a triggered MLTS node with live thermal imaging, is under development.
Core technical competences include low-power embedded sensor electronics, edge processing and sensor fusion, resilient communication between distributed nodes over low-bandwidth and intermittent links, and operator-centred software for sensor networks. The systems are designed for robustness in Arctic and subarctic conditions, autonomy under severe energy constraints, modularity and scalability - design drivers shared with space and remote-asset applications.

Company description: LGr Technologies AS is a Norwegian deep-tech SME based in Trondheim, developing modular, lightweight sensor systems for situational awareness in harsh and remote environments.
The company's core products are MLTS (Mobile Lightweight Tactical Sensor), a rapidly deployable perimeter sensor node that can be carried and installed by a single person and operates unattended for up to two weeks (approximately eight days at -30 degC), and Heimdall, a command-and-control software platform that fuses data from distributed MLTS nodes into a single real-time situational picture. A third system, Munin, a semi-autonomous human-in-the-loop UAV platform that responds to a triggered MLTS node with live thermal imaging, is under development.
Core technical competences include low-power embedded sensor electronics, edge processing and sensor fusion, resilient communication between distributed nodes over low-bandwidth and intermittent links, and operator-centred software for sensor networks. The systems are designed for robustness in Arctic and subarctic conditions, autonomy under severe energy constraints, modularity and scalability - design drivers shared with space and remote-asset applications.

description:
RoverAdvisory is the strategic advisory practice of Alessandro Rovera (M.Eng., Politecnico di Torino), based in Turin, Italy, focused on the aerospace sector and the Italian New Space ecosystem. We work with space startups, innovative SMEs, industrial players and investors on growth strategy, business planning and fundraising.
We support founders and management teams in defining business models, sharpening strategic positioning, building industrial and financial plans, and preparing companies for equity rounds. A core part of the work is helping space ventures turn strong technologies into credible business cases, investor narratives and fundraising materials that stand up to serious industrial and financial scrutiny, from business planning and investment case development to investor readiness, due diligence support and engagement with institutional and private investors.
Track record includes the 5 M€ round of Apogeo Space (IoT pico-satellite constellation) subscribed by Primo Space, and the multi-investor seed round of RevolvSpace (deployable structures for small satellites) with Primo Space and CDP Venture Capital; fractional CFO and management control for space startups; business planning and positioning for space technology projects incubated by ESA BIC Turin and developed within the Aerospace Lab of the CIM4.0 competence centre in Turin.
Alongside private capital raising, we support space companies in structuring innovation projects and accessing public funding instruments (Invitalia schemes, regional and national innovation incentives), and bring an evaluation-side perspective through work with investors and the assessment of applications to public calls on technological innovation. We collaborate with ecosystem players such as MESAP and CIM4.0 on aerospace initiatives. Earlier background: programme director at Comau, CFO of a UAV company, M&A advisor to mid-sized industrial companies, ten years as founder of a high-tech industrial holding with aerospace among its sectors.

entityDescription:
Founded in 2026 in Bordeaux, Orbitways develops embedded space risk management solutions deployed across the entire satellite lifecycle.
Faced with increasing orbital congestion and increasingly stringent regulatory requirements, our autonomous modules guarantee proactive collision avoidance and reliable deorbiting, whether at the end of a mission or in the event of an onboard failure.
By integrating these capabilities directly within the satellite itself, we offer operators and manufacturers a concrete lever for reducing operational and financial risks, ensuring sustainable compliance, and achieving technological sovereignty. Our ambition is to make Orbitways the standard for resilience in low Earth orbit by deploying a scalable, certifiable, and auditable architecture ready to equip the next generations of constellations and space missions.
